_doc._: GitHub identity for the EA's git tools (doc_review.py, site_tools.py, overleaf_tools.py). Lives at ~/.ea/config/github.json, owned by the owner, group-readable by ea-bot. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_doc.bot_login: GitHub login of the bot account the EA commits as (git user.name); the owner grants this account write access to each repository.
_doc.bot_email: The commit author email for that account, usually its <id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com address.
_doc.bot_token_dir: Directory name under ea-bot's ~/.config that holds the bot account's classic token for the sites (~/.config/<bot_token_dir>/token).
_doc.doc_review.repo: owner/name of the private repository where working documents are reviewed as pull requests; its fine-grained token is ~/.config/doc-review/token.
_doc.doc_review.owner_login: The owner's own GitHub login; only this login's review threads and reviews count.
_doc.sites: The sites the EA publishes, keyed by slug: title, repo (owner/name), url (the live site), and optional private (true: behind sign-in, publish cannot read it), deploy_note (one line for the lane) and build (the GitHub Actions workflow path that builds a Jekyll site).
